name: Everhour
summary: Everhour is free for up to 5 seats with limited features. Its Team plan costs $8.50 per seat a month on annual billing or $10 monthly, with a 5-seat minimum, and includes timesheet approval, invoicing and single sign-on.

evidence.capability: time entry or clock in and out

facts.text: A team of 2 or 3 people on the Team plan is still charged for 5 seats.
Everhour relies on its hosting provider's SOC 2 audit and hosts data on AWS in Oregon and Frankfurt.
Admins can export approved time entries to Deel for payroll.
Screenshots are a Team plan feature that an admin turns on for selected members, with an option to blur them.
The mobile app needs an internet connection to start and stop timers or add time entries.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 seats; no integrations or financial reports

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; $10 on monthly billing. Minimum 5 seats

hiddenCosts: The Team plan bills at least 5 seats, so the smallest annual Team plan costs $510 a year.

contract.cancellation: No refunds or credits for partial periods, and the account can be cancelled only inside the app, not by email or phone.
contract.dataExport: Reports as CSV, XLSX or PDF, and a full archive of time logs in JSON.
